Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the evidence and asserted that the “best match is ‘caused by parasites’,” framing DFTD as parasite-driven rather than a transmissible cancer. This contradicts the authoritative source it cited (Nature Communications), which clearly describes DFTD as a transmissible cancer (infectious tumor cells), leading toward the wrong conclusion instead of the correct option B (infectious, cell-cycle disease).
